thermal_semantics.frozen_legacy_adiabatic_label: NO_CONDUCTION_LOCAL_ADIABATIC: k=0, bath=0; local heat remains spatially heterogeneous
thermal_semantics.frozen_legacy_isothermal_label: FINITE_BATH: k=0.15 W/m/K and bath=2e10 W/m3/K; temperature is neither uniform nor prescribed
thermal_semantics.finite_conductivity_insulated: k>0, bath=0 with periodic spectral diffusion; not present in the frozen anchor/Tier1 pair
thermal_semantics.exact_prescribed_temperature: temperature identically fixed to T0; not present in the frozen anchor/Tier1 pair
thermal_semantics.causal_ablation: physical temperature and heat ledger evolve under NO_CONDUCTION_LOCAL_ADIABATIC, while only the named constitutive channel sees T0

evidence_selection.selection_rule: include both a broad response and the lowest-active invariant-clean response, irrespective of strict-positive status

initial_cases.name: broad_T1100_freeze_flow

initial_cases.name: broad_T1100_freeze_recovery
initial_cases.purpose: identify recovery thermal feedback in broad response
